data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities: Claims outstanding) 2015 comparative column. Claims development triangle present (gross, GBP 000s) and consistent with the balance sheet; no RITC distortion noted. Prior year development amount is small and explicitly stated.
